requirement: R1 - price-snapshot store with opening and closing numbers

capture_rules.opening: First capture at or after kickoff minus 48 hours.
capture_rules.closing: Last capture at or before kickoff minus 90 minutes.
capture_rules.usable_for_clv: A market is usable only when it holds one opening row and one closing row for the same operator.
capture_rules.why_fixed_in_advance: A capture instant chosen after the result is known lets a favourable number be selected retrospectively. Fixing the instants in advance removes that degree of freedom.
capture_rules.late_move: A move after the closing instant is recorded as a third row with capture_point = POST_CLOSE and is never used for a closing-line value.

schema.rule: Must match a market_id published by boards.py. A price for a market the lab does not originate is rejected.
Must match a game_id published by originate.py.
Kickoff in UTC, from the official schedule page.
The side, over/under, or club the number applies to.
Must be strictly before kickoff_utc. A capture taken after kickoff is not a price for that market.
The book or exchange the number came from. Anonymous prices are rejected.
The spread or total. Blank for a moneyline, which has no line.
American price. Blank is allowed only when the row records a line with no price.
Must be on a host registered in sources.py. A row without a reachable source is never published.
Must exist in the repository. The file holds the text actually read.
One of yes, no, pending. Only 'yes' rows enter a calculation.
Must be false. A filled, interpolated or modelled price is rejected; the store holds observations or nothing.

reasons: imputed: a modelled or interpolated number is not an observation
market_id: not a market this lab originates
evidence_file: no such file in the repository

empty_because: nfl.com returns HTTP 404 at /odds/; the rendered response contains no odds table, no price, no operator and no market list (CP-NFL-ODDS-ABSENT).
The official Week 10 game page read on 2026-11-14 prints a score, a by-quarter table, game info and a standings widget, and prints no spread, total or price.

No operator or sportsbook was consulted. NFL.com terms section 1.3 permit individual non-commercial informational use and prohibit systematic retrieval to compile a collection without written consent; no such consent is evidenced.
what_unblocks_it: A written licence or terms of use that permits retrieving and retaining opening and closing prices from a named operator, or
an official league publication that prints opening and closing numbers, which would then be registered in sources.py like any other source.
consequence: With zero rows there is no closing-line value, no return on investment, no staking column and no cash reward anywhere in this lab. Those cells are blank, not estimated.
